description: This SCSS file defines font-face rules for the Roboto font family, including various weights, and styles related to typography such as headings, blockquotes, dividers, and responsive heading sizes. It also includes styling for a divider and blockquote components, as well as some utility classes.
external_files: variables and mixins referenced via SCSS variables such as $roboto-font-path, $grid-breakpoints, $responsive-headings, and other variables like $divider-margin-y, $divider-height, etc.
